all.today: Firing cannot stop a reload. The gun branch of the trigger chain (29181) needs p.reloading<=0, so a press during a reload does nothing until tickReload (25480, called at 29064) finishes and adds rlRounds. A swap, a draw or going down cut a reload short (p.reloading=0 at 23721, 26466, 26657, 26717, 26813, 26925), but the trigger does not. tickReload adds rounds only at the end, so the rounds still in the magazine (p.ammo) are untouched while a reload runs. While the trigger is held during a reload no branch runs, so p.fired keeps the value it had: true if the trigger was held since before the reload, false after a release. The pad RT sets mouse.down (19902), so a change here covers the pad too. No older ruling forbids a cancel (the v5.44 comment at 29214 already calls the reload interruptible).
all.change: In updatePlayer, right after 'var hotGun=...'
